summary: Voice library carded out of the MPI-607 brainstorm: two voice kinds, performance-clip grid per pitch register, pipeline-generated auditions, two-number QA gate.
Large plan attached. 5 phases + one parallel batch; Phase 0 is an artefact gate that blocks clip authoring. Two decisions front-loaded for the user: where the bundle lives, and how many voices ship.
Phase 0 pickup - testing offline formant-preserving pitch shift as the R3-R5 performance-clip source

Phase 2: 12/12 performance clips authored with VoiceDesign under the GPU lease. Verify half (a) passes - all 8 low-arousal cells land inside their declared register band. New finding: emotion-driven pitch lift is register-asymmetric ~2:1 (R1 +9.9/+11.6 st vs R3 +4.8/+4.4 st). Angry and cheerful measure out-of-band by design and must NOT be shifted back.

Phase 2 items split into done/open; batch ownership corrected to the real component path (js/components/Compounds/MpiVoicePicker/) after the plan was found naming js/components/voicePicker.js, which this repo does not use.

Parallel batch landed: import pipeline (scripts/voice-library/ingest.py + 10-voice voices/ bundle) and MpiVoicePicker. Verified independently - lint clean, 737/737, 10/10 manifest contract checks, idempotence by SHA. Two worker-reported-clean defects found and root-fixed: a per-click component leak in the picker, and a 48kHz Opus encode escalated as a size decision on a false premise (soundfile does expose compression_level). Bundle halved to 44KB/voice = 2.5MB at the decided ~60.

Ask 2 PASSED - Fabio: the same guy. Identity holds across a 72.6 Hz emotion-driven pitch lift in R1, so the register asymmetry does not sink the grid. Root cause of the first listens distance impression was pitch_tools.py norm under-levelling high-crest clips at its peak ceiling, not the model rendering a different room (HF/LF delta +0.1 dB).

Ask 1: 5/6 emotions read correctly (angry, sad, cheerful, whisper, neutral). FLAT failed - it measures a 6.6 st pitch span against neutrals 5.8, so it moves MORE than the conversational read when it should be the narrowest of the six. Re-roll running with four prompt wordings and an objective gate of 3.5 st or under.

WRONG HYPOTHESIS RETRACTED: the flat cell is seed variance, not prompt wording. The original wording at a new seed hit 2.9 st (passes the gate) while all three harder rewordings landed 6.0-7.0 st, worse than the natural conversational read. Killed by the control kept in the same run. Flat is the one cell needing generate-and-measure; seed sweep running.

PHASE 2 COMPLETE - 12/12 emotion cells accepted by ear. Flat re-rolled and accepted (R1 seed 3600, R3 seed 3300); Fabio defined it better than the brief: soulless, in shock, empty, not paying attention - use as the picker description. My 3.5 st gate was calibrated on R1 and wrongly failed R3, whose neutral is naturally 8.9 st wide; gates must be relative to the register. 12 clips shipped to voices/performance/ and written into manifest.performanceClips, loader-verified.

CURATION PASS DONE - 60 voices imported of the 228 CC0 kyutai donations. All 227 usable were measured FIRST (boom is the one that does not measure - zero voiced frames), then the gates were set from the observed tails rather than picked in advance: voiced_frac >= 0.35 and snr_proxy >= 6.0 dB. Selected R1 26 / R2 15 / R3 17 / R4 1 / R5 1. voices/curated.txt is the audit trail - every selection with its reason, every rejection with the gate it failed. New scripts/voice-library/check_manifest.mjs runs 12 contract checks against the REAL loader: 12/12 at 60 voices, 737/737 node suite, byte-identical manifest on a second run, bundle 3.05 MB inside D1's 5 MB estimate.

THE CORPUS CANNOT SPAN R1-R5 AND THAT IS A SOURCING GAP, NOT A SELECTION ONE. Measured across all 227: R1 131, R2 62, R3 17, R4 1, R5 1, and 15 voices below the 90 Hz R1 floor. R4 is Aon at 263.2 Hz and R5 is Glenn at 365.9 Hz - one voice each, so no selection strategy produces a child or cartoon register from this source. R3/R4/R5 were taken WHOLE and R1/R2 quota'd down so the bundle corrects the corpus bias rather than reproducing it (R1 58 pct of corpus to 43 pct of bundle, R3 7 pct to 28 pct). Also: a quality gate at snr >= 8 dB would have ZEROED R4, since Aon scores 7.7 - the scarce registers set the ceiling on how strict any gate can be.

THREE MEASURED SIGNALS DELIBERATELY NOT USED AS GATES, which is the more useful half of the result. peak_dbfs discriminates nothing here: the corpus is already peak-normalised at max -1.0 dBFS with ZERO clipping. duration_s discriminates nothing: only 4 clips fall under 10 s and the shortest is 7.08 s. span_st is a RANK PENALTY only, never an exclusion - it is primarily a pyin octave-error tell, this card already logged a 21.4 st span on audio a listener passed, and gating on it would have dropped 3973 and spanish-limaperu, two of only seventeen R3 voices.

TWO DEFECTS ROOT-FIXED, NEITHER REPORTED BY ANYTHING. (1) The import hardcoded performanceClips: [] on every write, so the NEXT import of any kind would have silently deleted all twelve authored Phase 2 clips and left a well-formed manifest behind - no error, no warning. It now carries whatever is on disk through, and contract check 9 fails if that regresses. (2) My own f0-quartile spreading was a stride, not a quartile: by_f0[i::4] hands each group a sample of the WHOLE range, the opposite of spreading, and it made curated.txt claim a rationale the code never applied - the first selection skewed high, 22 of 26 R1 picks above 110 Hz. Now contiguous quarters, with each quartile's real Hz bounds written into the note so the claim is checkable.

kind 'both' on all 60 is CORRECT, not the defect the session-17 handoff suspected. A real human clip genuinely serves both the direct-TTS route and the VC-target route, so the kind filter is inert because the corpus is UNIFORM, not because the import is wrong. No kind, gender or age labels were invented from measurements - the same rule that keeps accent null. TWO DECISIONS ARE OPEN FOR FABIO and neither blocks Phase 3: the 15 voices below R1's 90 Hz floor (60.7-89.4 Hz, including 7020 at a healthy 0.692 voiced and 13.6 dB) have no band in brief.md section 2 and were EXCLUDED rather than silently filed under R1 - extend R1's floor, add an R0, or leave them out; and R4/R5 shipping with one voice each.

PHASE 4 USER-UX GATE CLOSED. Fabio ran Voice Changer end to end after an engine restart and confirmed all four fixes on screen plus the audio on headphones - 'Voice sounds good. Good match.' First generation in this card's history that produced audible speech.

THE FIRST RUN LOOKED LIKE A SUCCESS AND WAS NOT - no error, a gallery card, 'Generation finished', and an output of ONE SAMPLE (62 microseconds). Root cause: setuptools 83 removed pkg_resources, so resemble-perth's perth.perth_net fails to import and perth.PerthImplicitWatermarker is None - but `import perth` still succeeds, so chatterbox/vc.py sets PERTH_AVAILABLE=True and calls None(). FL_ChatterboxVC catches every exception and returns torch.zeros((1,2,1)) @ 16kHz, then reports success; its `message` output carries the error and our graph does not wire it. Fixed by uninstalling resemble-perth from the engine python - and the engine MUST be restarted after, since PERTH_AVAILABLE is read at import time. The pack's own requirements.txt keeps resemble-perth commented out, so a fresh engine is unaffected; how many existing users carry the leftover is UNKNOWN.

THE VANISHING GALLERY CARD WAS DATA LOSS, NOT A RENDER GLITCH, and the fix is generic. The card's <audio> could not decode the 1-sample flac, media-missing fired, and removeGroup deleted the entry from project.json while the media and sidecar stayed on disk. A decode failure and a deleted file raise the SAME error event, so any unplayable output silently deleted the only evidence of its own failure. Deletion now requires /file-exists to confirm the file is gone, and the check fails CLOSED (keeps the card) when it cannot run.

maturity in-progress -> validating (card stays in doing). Build work is done and user-verified; what remains is close-out: docs/voice-library.md, the honest wording for flowsRegistry's 'swaps the voice itself', a note to MPI-607 that the seed cap landed in its file territory, and the release-time question about the resemble-perth leftover.
